description_en: Lists all feature views and their available features in a project. Use this operation to select feature views and features for the CreateModelFeature and UpdateModelFeature operations
description_zh: 列出项目下所有特征视图及其可选的特征字段，用于为 CreateModelFeature 和 UpdateModelFeature 选取特征视图和字段
name: ListProjectFeatureViews

parameters.description_en: The ID of the instance. You can get this ID from the ListInstances operation.

parameters.name: instance_id

parameters.description_en: The ID of the project. You can get this ID from the ListProjects operation.

parameters.name: project_id
